{{Short description|German mathematician}}
'''Ulrich Görtz''' (1973)<ref name="Pressemitteilung"/> is a German mathematician specialising in [[arithmetic geometry]].

== Education and career ==
From 1993 to 1997, Görtz studied mathematics at the [[University of Münster]].<ref name="Pressemitteilung"/> He completed his PhD at the [[University of Cologne]] in 2000;<ref name="Pressemitteilung"/> his advisor was [[Michael Rapoport]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=92299}}</ref>
In 2006, Görtz [[habilitation|habilitated]] at the [[University of Bonn]].<ref name="Pressemitteilung"/>
From 2008 to 2009 he was the recipient of a Heisenberg-Stipendium of the [[German Research Foundation]] (DFG).
He received the Von-Kaven-Ehrenpreis of the DFG.<ref>{{cite web |title=UDE: Mathematik weiter im Aufwind |url=https://idw-online.de/de/news341595 |publisher=idw – Informationsdienst Wissenschaft |access-date=25 September 2021}}</ref>
Since 2009, Görtz has been a professor at the [[University of Duisburg-Essen]].<ref name="Pressemitteilung">{{cite web |title=Pressemitteilung der Universität Duisburg-Essen |url=https://www.uni-due.de/de/presse/meldung.php?id=1778 |publisher=Universität Duisburg-Essen |access-date=25 September 2021}}</ref>

==Books==
Together with {{ill|Torsten Wedhorn|de}}, Görtz authored the textbook ''Algebraic Geometry (Part I: Schemes)'' in 2010.<ref>{{cite book |title=Algebraic Geometry Part I: Schemes. With Examples and Exercises |url=https://www.springer.com/de/book/9783834897220 |publisher=Springer |access-date=25 September 2021}}</ref>
Since August 2015,<ref name="ESAGA">{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Ulrich Görtz |url=https://www.esaga.uni-due.de/ulrich.goertz/ |publisher=Essener Seminar |access-date=25 September 2021}}</ref> Görtz has been a member of the editorial board of the journal ''[[Results in Mathematics]]''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Results in Mathematics |url=https://www.springer.com/journal/25/editors |website=Springer.com |access-date=25 September 2021 |archive-date=25 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210925134421/https://www.springer.com/journal/25/editors |url-status=dead }}</ref>

* {{cite book | last=Görtz | first=Ulrich | last2=Wedhorn | first2=Torsten | title=Algebraic geometry. I, Schemes : with examples and exercises | publication-place=Wiesbaden, Germany | date=2020 | isbn=978-3-658-30733-2 | oclc=1181995650}}

== Personal life ==
Görtz is an [[Esperantist]], and had been active in the youth organisation of the German Esperanto Association.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ulrich Goertz (personal website) |url=https://www.g0ertz.de/ |access-date=26 September 2021}}</ref>
